2. This criminal appeal assails the judgment dated 20/01/2022 passed in ST No.509/2018 by Special Judge (POCSO Act) Gwalior, District Gwalior (M.P.); whereby, present appellant has been convicted as under:
 Section Imprisonment Fine w  stip Section 366 of IPC 05 Years' R.I. Rs Section 376(3) of IPC 20 Years' R.I. Rs Section 3/4 of POCSO 10 Years' R.I. Rs  Act Section 11/12 of POCSO 03 Years' R.I. Rs  Act 3.

sentences.text: It is the submission of counsel for appellant that trial Court erred in convicting and awarding jail sentence to present appellant.
He has already suffered around 7 years and 1 month of incarceration as pre and post trial confinement and hearing of appeal shall take some time.
From the statement of prosecutrix, it appears that appellant and prosecutrix shared emotional and physical proximity with consent.
She left her maternal home with appellant on her own volition and did not raise any alarm when stayed with appellant.
She is at the cusp of attaining majority.
He already suffered sufficient period of custody.
He has good case on merits and final hearing of appeal would take some time.
He undertakes to abide by all terms and conditions as imposed by this Court.
Under such circumstances, he prays for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
4. Counsel for respondent/State opposed the application and prayed for its dismissal.

sentences.text: Heard the counsel for parties and perused the record.

6. Considering the submissions advanced and the fact that appellant suffered more than 7 years of incarceration and case appears to be prima facie of consensual nature, therefore, this Court, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, intends to allow the application for suspension of sentence (I.A.No.20122/2025).
7.

If appellant-Sani alias Sanni furnishes bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) along with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court that he shall appear before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 04/02/2026 and thereafter, on all other subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Office for appearance, then he shall be released on bail and execution of jail sentence is suspended till disposal of this appeal, subject to deposit of fine amount.
8.
The appellant shall not be source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant/victim side and her family member in any manner.

He shall not move in their vicinity and will not try to contact them in person/through somebody else or through electronic media; otherwise, benefit of bail given today by way of suspension of sentence shall be withdrawn immediately.
9. I.A.No.20122/2025 stands disposed of, accordingly.
10. Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for information and necessary compliance.
11. Certified copy as per rules.
